scope: One genuine stock Blender import under the approved unused-point amendment, followed only after PASS by independent full readback and separately admitted one-view CPU rendering and image reopening. This is source review, not an actual import or visual PASS.

review_independence.host_changes: Root added the pre-marker measured import process and Job headroom check. A separate reviewer covered the final exact host bytes and recorded GO with no findings.

focused_evidence.scope: Synthetic exact compaction, position/triangle/corner order and multiplicity, malformed bounds, native-oracle association and excess-quantization rejection, plus fixed actual supervisor commands and limits.

approved_geometry_contract.comparison: Every referenced source position must retain exact F32 bits in sorted original-index correspondence. Every remapped original triangle retains exact face order, corner order, winding and multiplicity. No welding, repair, extra removal or coordinate alteration.

colour_and_material_review.native_oracle: All original F32 linear RGB rows pass through bounded 32768-row POINT BYTE_COLOR setter batches; imported CORNER values must use the identical ByteColorAttributeValue RNA class. Every actual corner RGBA byte must equal its original-vertex oracle byte exactly, with alpha255.
colour_and_material_review.independent_quantization_gate: Every imported corner is measured against original F32; encoded RGB maximum absolute error must be <=0.5/255+2e-6. Linear and encoded RMSE/max are reported separately; byte storage is not claimed F32 exact.
colour_and_material_review.material: Pinned prior reader verifies original constant metallic/roughness, resolved vertex-colour-to-Principled wiring, opaque alpha1, no texture/normal/displacement inputs and double-sided material. Unit glTF base factor remains bound by the prior exact full-file proof.

stage_review.import_stage: One stock GLB call only, preceded by a durable exact-input/settings journal and flushed pre-call marker. Read actual geometry and corner bytes, verify them, and save readbacks plus private inspected.blend. No render in this process.
stage_review.verify_stage: A separately authored owned D Python worker authenticates source and all five saved files, compares every row and corner with bounded NumPy batches, verifies exact material/native-oracle evidence and records all output hashes.
stage_review.render_stage: Requires import and independent verify PASS with exact predecessor host/worker receipt binding; opens the saved inspected.blend without GLB reimport, rechecks geometry and material, and renders only one +X view. Imported flat shading and source colours remain unchanged.
stage_review.inspect_stage: Reopens the actual640x640RGB PNG, rejects a blank image and creates a labelled private contextual comparison to the authenticated prior +2EV PBR image. This file check cannot substitute for independent visual inspection.

render_settings.camera_and_lights: Authenticated original positive-X orthographic camera and neutral studio rig
render_settings.reference_comparison: Contextual only: source sampling and gamma/shading semantics differ; no pixel-perfect numerical-equivalence claim.

resource_and_ownership_review.render_admission: Both measured import peaks must leave at least1GiB under unchanged6GiB caps before a render marker is created; current live resource floors must also pass.
resource_and_ownership_review.supervision: Exact HEAD/branch and reviewed source/plan/log/prior-audit pins, fixed commands, fresh exclusive per-stage outputs, predecessor PASS and exact receipt binding, binary GO after Job attachment, periodic health checks, unchanged sources/prior outputs and natural empty owned Job without forced cleanup are required.
resource_and_ownership_review.memory_projection_limit: Prior source allocation ledger and readback estimates inform admission; they are not measured Blender peaks or a proof of a process-wide upper bound. Hard process and Job caps remain enforced.

stop_rule: If any stage or its owned host fails, preserve evidence and stop; no automatic retry, second import, extra view, raised limit, geometry repair or importer patch.
